lessons.title: My Saturday plan
lessons.en:
Anna: Look at my plan for Saturday!
Ben: Cool! What will you do first?
Anna: First I'll read a book. Then I'll play with my dog.
Ben: And next?
Anna: Next I'll finish my homework. After that, we can play together!
lessons.cn:
安娜：看我周六的计划！
本：酷！你首先要做什么？
安娜：我先读书，然后陪我的狗玩。
本：然后呢？
安娜：接下来我做完作业。之后我们就可以一起玩了！

lessons.title: A clock on the wall
lessons.en: There is a big clock on the wall. It tells me the time. At seven, I get up. At eight, I am at school. At twelve, it's time for lunch. At four, school is over. At seven in the evening, I finish my homework. Time goes fast — make a good plan every day!
lessons.cn: 墙上有一只大钟。它告诉我时间。七点起床。八点我在学校。十二点是午餐时间。四点放学。晚上七点我做完作业。时间过得真快——每天都要做个好计划！
